contexts.text: A great gulf between them () = removal itself from good, which also gives the appearance of an intervening gulf. Explained.
A great gulf = the opposition and contrariety of the states of life.

Near the end of our solar system, there appeared... a fiery smoke ascending from a great gulf. There was a huge our solar world on that side... I was being borne across this middle part, when underneath, in that gulf or gulf, there appeared very many men, who were Spirits. AC 9583.
The Hells open only through fissures, and through gulfs... HH 585.
Like great gulfs, and gulfs.
The evil were cast into two great gulfs there, which tended obliquely into the deep.
The monks, together with the common people... were partly cast into... the great southern gulf; partly into the western gulf...
Some of their mountains opened in the middle, where a huge gulf was made that was drawn round into a spiral; and those who were upon them were cast in thither.
Here and there there were made gulfs towards the Hells which were beneath them, and thus communication was opened with them.
How can Heaven enter Hell, since between them there is fixed so great a gulf...
Suddenly the ground yawned...
The ground yawned, and through the gulf there ascended three devils...
There then appeared an opening between them and the Angels; and the light of Heaven flowing in over the opening opened the interiors of their minds...
Between which and Heaven there is a huge gulf.
Presently the ground yawned... and lo through the opening there flew out birds of night... and locusts.
He separates the latter from the former by a gulf, lest the Hells should do violence to Heaven, and lest Heaven should inflict torment on Hell...
Afterwards He opened a great gulf between the Hells and the Heavens, which no one from Hell can cross...
It is this interspace which is meant by the great gulf fixed between those who are in Heaven and those who are in Hell (). TCR 475:3. DeConj 60. Coro 20.

It is on account of this opposition that between Heaven and Hell there is a gulf, which cannot be passed over... The like happens to those who are in Hell, if they pass over the middle part of this gulf.
An open throat...
A gulf opened there... SE 5231. SE 5232. SE 5237. SE 5238. SE 5264. SE 5274. SE 5341:end. SE 5347. SE 5359. SE 5363. SE 5473. SE 5475. SE 5477. LJPost 18.
The earth yawned...
